# Crosscurrent
Crosscurrent is an independent crypto bridge news publication.
It covers cross-chain liquidity, bridge launches, outages, exploits, and protocol upgrades.
Reporting is written for builders, traders, and users who need clear technical context.
Crosscurrent is editorially independent and does not provide financial advice.

- Home: https://cryptogurutalk.github.io/
- About: https://cryptogurutalk.github.io/about/
